Broken Rake

Fall Lager

Malty · Amber · Autumn

ABV
~3.0%
IBU
18
Color
Amber

A bold, malty, amber lager brewed for cool evenings, backyard fires, and the season of gathering.

Broken Rake began with a plan for a pumpkin festbier. The brew day had other ideas. With pumpkin and spice taking a quieter role than expected, a rich malt character stepped forward and gave this beer a fall identity all its own.

Made for settling into a chair, sharing a story, and lingering a little longer with friends and family. From Pan de Campo to the holiday table, Broken Rake belongs wherever good company gathers.

The plan changed. The moment didn’t.
